title: add-benchmark-lab-reporting-pipeline-v12
author: Leah Chen
release_notes: Add v12 of the benchmark-lab reporting pipeline: supports aggregated profiling baselines, representative workload runners, improved failure retry semantics, and CI integration for nightly runs.
description: Context: The benchmark lab has been expanded to include production-aligned reporting for representative workload runs and profiling baselines. This change bundles a new reporting pipeline (v12) that consolidates per-run metrics, computes baseline deltas, and emits artifacts consumable by the dashboards and canary jobs. Motivation: make profiling baselines first-class, reduce triage time after perf regressions, and enable automated alerts when representative workloads diverge from baselines. What this PR does: - Adds a reporting pipeline orchestration that ingests workload run results and profiling data, computes baseline comparisons, and writes summarized artifacts to the reporting bucket. - Adds representative workload runners and standardized output schema for easier aggregation. - Adds baseline generation code and retention policy (keep last 7 stable baselines). - Adds retry/backoff for flaky upstream artifact reads and idempotency keys for pipeline tasks. - Wire CI: nightly workflow and additional unit/integration tests for the reporting path. Checklist: - [x] New pipeline orchestration implemented - [x] Representative workload runners added for text-gen and embeddings workloads - [x] Baseline comparison logic with configurable thresholds - [x] Tests (unit and integration) added and passing - [x] Documentation updates to benchmark-lab README and runbook - [x] Nightly CI workflow configured Breaking: none; no runtime changes to serving code. Rollout plan: merge to main, promote nightly workflow; monitor last-24h job success rate and alert on >2 failures in a 24h window. Usage notes: run `./benchmark-lab/bin/run_workload --profile rtextgen --commit <sha>` to enqueue representative runs. Outputs are written to gs://redwood-bench-reports/v12/<date>/ and automatically picked up by the dashboard job.
